prompt:
Bug: fetching a multi-purpose label that does not exist answers 500.

GET /api/groups/labels/{item_id} with the id of a label that does not exist (any random UUID) fails with an internal server error. The other organizer endpoints (tags, categories, tools, units, foods) answer 404 for a missing item.

Expected: GET /api/groups/labels/{item_id} answers 404 when the group has no label with that id; an existing label is returned as before.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration_tests/user_household_tests` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 8 minutes).
title: fix: labels get-by-id returns 404 instead of 500 for missing id (#8227)
